workload.definition: campaigns/2026/rq17-flashnext-quality/tasks.json (predeclared 2026-10-10, frozen before any result exists; its sha256 is recorded in preflight evidence)
workload.cells: one discarded same-shape warmup; 6 canaries (batt-arith/capital/token/sumsq/logic/json token files on T-FORCE) x2 runs greedy gen 512; 3x3 replay drift gen 256 (batt-arith/batt-logic/batt-json, engine one-shot launches, output-id lines token-identical across reps); 10 representative host tasks greedy gen 512 with deterministic scorers; 8K two-turn KV-edge check (p8192 text + arithmetic question, then first-word follow-up; turn-1 rendered prompt >= 8100 tokens; per-turn gen raised by the adapter from the frozen tasks.json value 64 to the RL-152 floor 512, texts and scorers unchanged); content-only scoring with reasoning and content token counts logged separately per cell; finish_reason=length classed truncated-never-wrong; scripts/tmp/gpu_guard_20261011.sh called before AND after every cell on both render nodes (foreign inference PID -> that cell aborted as contaminated, lane paused with exit 3, PIDs recorded and never killed)
workload.sampling: greedy (temperature 0) everywhere; replay one-shot cells pass --greedy
workload.client: single sequential client (the adapter); one request in flight at a time
workload.scoring: deterministic Python scorers in scripts/tmp/rq17_battery_20261010.py keyed from the frozen tasks.json; content-only (message.content; reasoning_content retained as evidence, never scored); raw responses retained per cell
workload.token_exactness: Amended 2026-10-11 before attempt 2 (RL-152 mechanism, attempt 2 of 2): each canary's rendered prompt_tokens must equal batt-file ids + the serve surface's fixed chat-template overhead of 44 tokens (22/20/22/28/31/26 + 44 = 66/64/66/72/75/70) in BOTH runs. The overhead was measured identical on every canary in RL-144 and RL-156 raw; the attempt-1 conjunct compared rendered to bare file counts and was unsatisfiable by construction (RL-156). Mismatch fails measurement_validity, never adjusted.
workload.cell_order: warmup, canaries run A, tasks, 8K two-turn, canaries run B, serve stop, replay 3x3; every request and every replay launch bracketed by guard calls
workload.host_memory_guard: Amended 2026-10-11 before attempt 3 (RL-158): every guard call (before and after every cell) also reads /proc/meminfo MemAvailable and /proc/pressure/memory; MemAvailable < 8192 MiB or memory PSI full avg10 > 5.0 classes the cell contaminated (never wrong) and pauses the lane. The run executes in its own systemd user unit, not the interactive terminal scope; no CPU-heavy lane runs beside it.

evidence_rationale: Attempt 4 = second attempt of the RL-158 mechanism (same changed_variable as RL-159). RL-159 was contaminated by the lead's co-scheduled subagent CPU lanes in breach of the declared isolation; the guard caught it (PSI) after an xe engine reset on GPU0 (RL-160). This run executes with no subagent or CPU-heavy job active on the host. Plan otherwise byte-identical to attempt 3; gates unchanged. Attempt 3. Attempt 1 (RL-156) passed every quality element and failed only an unsatisfiable token conjunct; attempt 2 (RL-158) was killed by systemd-oomd from the lead's co-scheduled CPU lanes after 22/24 serve cells (all completed cells consistent with RL-156). This attempt keeps the amended conjunct and adds the host-memory guard and isolated execution; gates unchanged. Re-entry attempt 1 of the fresh RL-152 mechanism pair (new changed_variable; zero prior manifests match it, so the max_attempts=2 budget is fresh). RL-144 scored canaries 4/6 only because the frozen gen-64 budget truncated CORRECT computation inside reasoning_content (batt-arith '7' = first digit of 703; the reasoning reaches 740 on the way to 703), and its replay UR_RESULT_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST (rc 139) was foreign llama-loop contention, per the operator re-entry decision D2 recorded as RL-152: NO canary produced a wrong answer, so the pre-declared stop rule (ADR-0011 REOPENED_QUALITY_FAILURE) never fired. This plan changes only the battery budget and scoring mechanism: canary/host-task/8K-turn2 gen >= 512, replay gen >= 256, content-only scoring with reasoning and content token counts logged separately, finish_reason=length classed truncated-never-wrong (truncation or contamination alone = blocked with cause via measurement_validity or a non-zero exit, NEVER a quality failure), and the render-node foreign-process guard bracketing every cell. Gates are unchanged and nothing that could lower them is introduced: the correctness check still fires on any wrong canary (finish stop + scorer miss) or replay drift, the success gate is still all 6 canaries correct in both runs, 3x3 replays token-identical, >= 8/10 host tasks, 8K two-turn correct. Route, config of record, artifact identities, server lifecycle, container naming, port and single-client discipline are byte-for-byte the RL-144 coordinates; minimum_relative_gain stays 0.0 (quality gate, not speed). Budget arithmetic from RL-144 per-cell timings scaled to the new budgets (engine load 354 s; serve decode 17.7-26.4 tok/s; 8.2K prefill ~12 s; replay one-shot ~120 s fixed load + 28.77 tok/s decode; guard 0.71 s/call) gives a worst-case battery phase of ~2725 s inside the 3300 s adapter deadline and the 3600 s screen timeout, with preflight and cleanup as separate bounded phases; the full arithmetic is predeclared in scripts/tmp/rq17_budget_notes_20261011.md.
measurements_note: The adapter reads the frozen plan.json from B70_RUN_DIR and copies metric/unit/identities/controlled verbatim into measurements.json; baseline/candidate are arrays of {pair, value} over the 6 canary pairs; checks carry quality, correctness, isolation and measurement_validity, each with a relative evidence file under the run root. Check semantics for this mechanism (predeclared, per RL-152): correctness fails only on a WRONG canary or replay drift (the stop rule); truncated cells and contamination block through measurement_validity / a non-zero exit (blocked with cause), never as a quality failure. reasoning vs content token counts per cell are recorded in measurement_validity.token_counts_reasoning_vs_content; every guard call is recorded in raw/guard/guard_log.jsonl.
